_documentation.PURPOSE: Which file goes to which social network: size, shape, frame rate, length limit, who posts, and when (postTimesJst: the daily slots in the audience's time; a weekday prefix makes it weekly).
_documentation.OVERVIEW: Read by py/studio/reels.py (packaging) and server/editor.html (Exports tab).
_documentation.USAGE: Each channel lists its files. aspect is the master it is cut from; w/h is the delivered size.
_documentation.NOTES: Checked 2026-11-07: Instagram Help (>=720p, >=30 fps, reels over 3 min not recommended), X web upload (<=1920x1200 / 1200x1900 portrait, <=40 fps, 140 s), LinkedIn Help (10-60 fps, 3 s-15 min), YouTube Shorts (vertical, <=3 min, <=1080p). 30 fps everywhere: it is inside every platform's range.

channels.name: Instagram Reels
channels.who: Off by default: turn it on in Settings › Accounts
channels.note: Over 3 min is not shown to non-followers. Add trending audio in the app.

channels.name: Threads
channels.note: The post text is the hook: end on a question, put the link in the first reply.

channels.name: Facebook (Reel + feed)
channels.note: 9:16 for Reels, 4:5 for the page feed.

channels.name: YouTube Shorts
channels.note: Vertical and 3 min or less counts as a Short.

channels.name: TikTok
channels.note: Same 9:16 file. Business account: Commercial Music Library only; no bio link until the account is registered or verified.
channels.blocker: Bio and photo do not save: open TikTok Studio › More tools › Account check and look for "Restricted from editing your profile". Until that clears, change the bio and photo in the TikTok app.

channels.name: X
channels.note: Under 15 s does best, captions burnt in for sound-off viewing. Web upload caps portrait at 1200x1900 and 40 fps, so the 9:16 is 1068x1900.

channels.name: LinkedIn
channels.note: 4:5 fills the mobile feed. 30 fps recommended.

channels.name: Google Business Profile
channels.note: Video 30 s and 75 MB at most, 720p or higher. Can take 24-48 h to show on Maps.

channels.name: LINE VOOM
channels.note: Short video 60 s at most, one per post. No other networks' IDs on screen or in the text; the first URL becomes a link card.

channels.name: LINE message (rich video)
channels.who: Your LINE official account, to your friends
channels.note: Rich video message, mp4, 200 MB at most; vertical fills the chat. Best kept for news (a monthly drop), not every reel.

channels.name: Pinterest
channels.note: Video Pin 4 s to 5 min, 9:16. A Pin can carry the link.

channels.name: Bluesky
channels.note: One video per post, 3 min at most. Text is 300 characters at most.

channels.name: Zenn
channels.note: Zenn embeds YouTube; upload there and link.

channels.name: Xiaohongshu (RED)
channels.note: No links, QR codes or other IDs in the post.
